name: USGS Earthquake Catalog API
tagline: Real-time and historical global earthquake data from the USGS Earthquake Catalog
description: USGS provides free, no-key public web services for real-time and historical earthquake data worldwide. The primary FDSN Event Web Service returns GeoJSON (and other formats) for queries by time, magnitude, location, and depth, plus real-time GeoJSON summary feeds for significant events. Data powers maps, alerts, research, and monitoring apps. No authentication is required for standard catalog and feed endpoints.

auth.details: No authentication required for public FDSN Event and GeoJSON summary feed endpoints; free open government data.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public API; no paid plans. Usage expected to be reasonable; heavy automated use may be throttled.

rate_limits: Not published as a fixed quota; USGS asks for reasonable use and may throttle abusive traffic. Prefer GeoJSON summary feeds for real-time maps over high-frequency catalog queries.

use_cases: query recent earthquakes above a magnitude threshold worldwide
fetch historical quakes in a bounding box for a date range
get real-time GeoJSON feed of significant earthquakes for a map
look up details for a specific earthquake event ID
count earthquakes matching magnitude and time filters
